units.source_text: 不大一会儿，秀男就走出店铺，他总觉得这还是个谜。

en.t: Before long, Hideo left the shop, still feeling that it remained a mystery.

units.source_text: 但他毕竟开始动脑子考虑腰带的构图。

en.t: But he had, after all, begun to put his mind to the composition of the obi.

units.source_text: 设计赤松山和杉树山图案，非要有相当的气魄不可。

en.t: To design a pattern of red-pine mountains and cedar mountains, one would need a considerable boldness of spirit.

units.source_text: 不然，作为千重子的腰带，恐怕太朴素了。

en.t: Otherwise, as an obi for Chieko, it would probably be too plain.

units.source_text: 在秀男来说，他认为这是千重子的腰带。

en.t: As far as Hideo was concerned, he regarded it as Chieko's obi.

units.source_text: 不，如果是那位叫苗子的姑娘的，就得设计与她劳动生活相近的图案，正如他曾向千重子说过的那样。

en.t: No, if it were for that girl named Naeko, he would have to design a pattern closer to her life of labor, just as he had once told Chieko.
